children: Iron ore futures climbed toward CNY 690 per ton, recovering some ground after hitting four-year lows last week, as expectations of restocking by Chinese steelmakers following an extended holiday provided support, although weak market fundamentals continued to limit gains.
More mills are expected to return to the spot market this week to replenish raw material inventories and maintain production levels.
Meanwhile, lower spot coke prices helped ease cost pressures and narrow steelmakers’ losses, potentially slowing the pace of production cuts.
However, signs of rising global supply capped the upside, as miners increased shipments to meet quarterly and annual targets in the fourth quarter.
Recent data also revealed that only 6.9% of Chinese steelmakers were profitable at the end of September, highlighting persistent challenges across the sector.

title: Iron Ore Stabilizes on Chinese Steel Mill Restocking Hopes
